name: @nkzw/audio
description: Cross-platform audio playback for the web.

scripts.build: VERSION=`printf 'v' && node -e 'console.log(require("./package.json").version)'` && sed -i '' '2s|.*| *  @nkzw/audio '"$VERSION"'|' src/audio.core.js && sed -i '' '4s|.*| *  @nkzw/audio '"$VERSION"'|' src/plugins/audio.spatial.js && uglifyjs --preamble "/*! @nkzw/audio $VERSION | (c) 2013-2020, James Simpson of GoldFire Studios | MIT License */" src/audio.core.js -c -m --screw-ie8 -o dist/audio.core.min.js && uglifyjs --preamble "/*! @nkzw/audio $VERSION | Spatial Plugin | (c) 2013-2020, James Simpson of GoldFire Studios | MIT License */" src/plugins/audio.spatial.js -c -m --screw-ie8 -o dist/audio.spatial.min.js && awk 'FNR==1{echo ""}1' dist/audio.core.min.js dist/audio.spatial.min.js | sed '3s~.*~/*! Spatial Plugin */~' | perl -pe 'chomp if eof' > dist/audio.min.js && awk '(NR>1 && FNR==1){printf ("\n\n")};1' src/audio.core.js src/plugins/audio.spatial.js > dist/audio.js
